title: Open-Face Tofu Sandwiches with Lettuce, Tomato, Avocado & Mixed Salad

steps.text: Cut tofu into ½-inch thick slices along the short side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, sprinkle tofu with cornstarch, salt, and pepper on both sides.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add tofu and cook, flipping once, until golden brown, 6-8 minutes. Return to the baking sheet.
Meanwhile, juice lemon into a medium bowl; add oil, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots; add to the bowl with the dressing.

Separate lettuce leaves; set aside 2 leaves per serving (1 leaf per sandwich) and chop or tear remaining leaves into bite-sized pieces. Add chopped lettuce to the bowl, along with broccoli slaw, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Halve and pit avocado; cut crosswise while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
Spread mayo over each bread slice; layer slices with lettuce, tomato, tofu, and avocado.
To serve, divide salad and sandwiches between plates. Enjoy!
